description: 2 tactical challenges for Black against the Wing Gambit. Decline solidly or take and counter in the center.

drills.briefExplanation: 1...c5 2.b4 b6! 3.bxc5 bxc5 — decline, trade, and keep the solid structure.
drills.description: Black to play. White is hinting at the Wing Gambit — play 1...c5 and decline with 2...b6!.
drills.explanation: The solid decline: after 1...c5 2.b4, Black plays 2...b6! — refusing the pawn. After 3.bxc5 bxc5 Black's structure is sound, the b-pawn trade opened nothing for White, and the queenside weakening (a3 played to no purpose) is White's alone. Declining well is a defensive art.
drills.name: The Solid Decline

drills.briefExplanation: 2...cxb4 3.a3 d5! — take the pawn, then strike in the center at once.
drills.description: Black to play. White played the Wing 2.b4 — take and counter with 3...d5!.
drills.explanation: The active defense: take with 2...cxb4, and after 3.a3 strike 3...d5! — countering in the center before White builds pressure. After 4.exd5 Qxd5 Black is a pawn up with a centralized queen and easy development. White's open files mean little when Black's center is mobile and the extra pawn is secure.
drills.name: Take and Counter

name: Wing Gambit — Black Tactics
